documents.text: Sinbar. method. Master Sinbar, academy trial. Speak with Master Sinbar to initiate the trial.
Disintegrator field. method. moving field, academy walls. Avoid the moving disintegrator field (stay close to walls).
Spear gauntlets. objective. stationary spears, rising spears. Bypass stationary and rising spear gauntlets.
Academy fire jets. objective. academy pressure plates. Navigate pressure plates and fire jets.
Academy final chest. acquisition. starting equipment. Open the final chest to claim starting equipment.
Academy teleporter. route. northern teleporter, exit to Zaratan. Step into the northern teleporter to exit to Zaratan.
Academy vases. acquisition. bonus gold coins. Smash all vases along the way for bonus gold coins.
Family Sword of Honor. acquisition. Zubin sword, family sword. Meet Aliya at the gates and speak with Zubin to get the Family Sword of Honor.
Jessamin. identity. Mother, family gift. Visit Mother (Jessamin) and Aunt (get family gift).
Babazar. requirement. sick daughter, purple desert berries. Accept Babazar's quest to find purple desert berries for his sick daughter.
Haroon abi Wassab. method. Aliya treaty, peace negotiation. Bring Aliya before Haroon abi Wassab to negotiate the treaty.
Qadi peace treaty. method. oath with Aliya, Haroon oath. Swear the oath with Aliya before Haroon to sign the Qadi's peace treaty.
Muliban accusation. outcome. family banishment. Witness the genie Muliban's accusation, resulting in your family's banishment.
Purple Berries. acquisition. oasis berries. Collect the Purple Berries from the oasis bushes.
Oasis mermaid. method. mermaid pool quest. Converse with the mermaid at the pool and accept her quest.
Giant Boar. objective. oasis outskirts boar. Defeat the giant boar roaming the oasis outskirts for XP.
Mermaid sister. objective. stone cell rescue. Rescue the mermaid's sister locked in the stone cell.
Dock dark mage. objective. dock entrance mage. Defeat the dark mage guarding the dock entrance.
Rotting Ship's Hold. objective. undead hold, zombies hold. Enter the Rotting Ship's Hold and clear all zombies.
Ship Orb. acquisition. helm cabin orb. Retrieve the Ship Orb from the helm cabin.
Corsair ship. use. sea navigation, restore ship. Restore your ship to enable navigation across the sea.
Rotting Ship's Hold barrels. acquisition. hidden healing potions. Smash barrels in the ship's hold to find hidden healing potions.
Mirror optics puzzle. objective. tower light reflection. Solve the mirror optics and light reflection puzzle.
Acid Slime King. objective. toxic pool neutralization. Defeat the Acid Slime King to neutralize the toxic pool.
Captured tower mage. method. tower blessing. Free the captured tower mage to receive his blessing.
Tower Level 2 tile puzzle. objective. optional pressure-plate tile puzzle. Solve the optional pressure-plate tile puzzle on Level 2 for items.
Traveler's Rest. objective. Closed Inn, Capital City inn. Visit the Closed Inn (Traveler's Rest) and converse with patrons.

Zubakon. location. shop with no sign, sword trainer, Zubakon location, signless shop, sword trainer location. Visit Zubakon at the shop with no sign to learn any new sword swings you are eligible for.
Caliph audience. method. Vizier audience. Request an audience with the Caliph via the Vizier.
Vizier mind scan. method. telepathic scan. Submit to the Vizier's mind scan.
Caliph questions. method. absolute honesty. Answer the questions with absolute honesty.
Shibaz Hermit. objective. Hermit hut guidance. Locate the Hermit's hut and accept his guidance.
Flying Carpet. acquisition. harpy nest carpet. Retrieve the Flying Carpet from the harpy nest.
Hags riddle. objective. Library path riddle. Solve the hags' riddle to open the path to the Library.
Library levels. objective. library maze, L1 to L3. Navigate through levels L1 to L3.
Bottle of Eternal Emptiness. acquisition. Senat bottle. Retrieve the Bottle of Eternal Emptiness from the center of volcanic Isle of Senat.
Efreet agent. method. bottle trap, capture Efreet. Trap the Efreet agent in the bottle.
Chessboard. route. Marid North, Djinns East, Daos West. Navigate the Chessboard: Marid (North), Djinns (East), Daos (West).
Efreet Potion. use. South chessboard path, Efreet Lord potion. Drink the potion, cross the South chessboard path, and learn the truth from the Efreet Lord.
Sumie. location. kitchen fireplace, orange clothing. Meet Sumie in the kitchen (wearing orange near fireplace).
Office of Trade. method. baker referral. Visit the Office of Trade to receive the baker referral.
Key of Bone. acquisition. Baker key, market baker. Speak to the Baker in the market to claim the Key of Bone.
Sumie. method. kitchen cellar door. Return to Sumie to unlock the kitchen cellar door.
Old Dungeon hidden key. acquisition. boulder first room key. Retrieve the hidden key behind a boulder in the first room.
Old Dungeon vents. method. poison vents, flame vents. Time your run past the poison and flame vents.
Pangar-Bek. method. cyclops escort, dungeon exit, escort Pangar-Bek, Pangar-Bek escort destination. Locate and escort the cyclops Pangar-Bek to the dungeon exit.
New Dungeon. objective. stealth section. Enter the New Dungeon (Stealth Section - Do not get caught).
New Dungeon pressure plates. objective. security pressure plates, security pressure plate objective, New Dungeon pressure plate objective. Bypass the security pressure plates.
Zubin cell. method. Zubin revelation. Locate Zubin's cell and listen to his revelation.
Vizier's Journal. acquisition. conspiracy journal, Vizier desk. Search the Vizier's desk to retrieve his conspiracy journal.
Al'Katraz mercenary groups. objective. warring mercenary factions. Interact with the two warring mercenary groups.
Al'Katraz password. acquisition. three elemental shrines. Solve the three elemental shrines to reveal the password.
Al'Katraz Prison Dungeon. requirement. prison password. Enter Al'Katraz Prison Dungeon using the password.
Ettin guards. objective. prison Ettins. Defeat the Ettin guards.
Prison keys. acquisition. Mercenary Captain keys. Defeat the Mercenary Captain to obtain the prison keys.
Tarik. method. brother rescue, escort to ship, escort Tarik, Tarik escort destination, brother ship escort. Rescue Tarik and escort him back to the ship.
Sand genies. objective. Aballat genies. Converse with the sand genies.
Voice-trapping bottles. objective. voice bottles. Locate the voice-trapping bottles.
Tarik voice. objective. restore speech, Tarik voice restoration objective. Restore Tarik's voice.
Al-Naqqil teleporter traps. objective. teleporter traps. Evade the teleporter traps.
Magic necklaces. acquisition. three Nameless mages, magic neck pieces. Defeat the three Nameless mages to claim their magic necklaces.
Outer Planes gateway. objective. open gateway. Open the gateway to the Outer Planes.
Floating platform grids. objective. Outer Planes platforms. Cross the floating platform grids.
Kara. objective. rogue genie, corrupted genie. Defeat the rogue genie Kara.
Magical shield orbs. objective. shield orbs, final orbs. Destroy the magical shield orbs.
Vizier finale. objective. Genie's Curse, cleanse curse. Defeat the Vizier and cleanse the Genie's Curse.
Starting Corsair. identity. starting level, starting character. You begin as a second-level seafaring warrior: lightly equipped, quick on your feet, and already skilled with the scimitar.
Combat rhythm. explanation. real time combat, three action circles. Combat is real time. The three action circles appear in dangerous areas and show which sword swings are currently available.

Scimitar facing. use. Alt direction lock, lock facing direction, scimitar aiming, unlock facing when surrounded. Your scimitar strikes in the direction you face. Press Alt to lock that direction in a corridor; unlock when surrounded.

Sword swing controls. use. action circles, orange circles, basic attack controls, sword swing timing, hold and release sword attack. Click for the quick attack. Hold the action button longer and release when the second or third circle lights orange.

Sword recovery. combat. readying pause, attack recovery, sword readying pause, make space after a hit. Every blow has a brief readying pause. Land a clean hit, make space, then begin the next attack before closing again.

Left hand weapon. use. seeking sling, Space fire, left hand aiming, fire seeking sling, fire magic shard, Space key. Ready either the seeking sling or one magic shard. Fire with Space in the direction your Corsair last faced.

Moonstone shard charges. use. empty shard, fragment charges, finite shard charges, shard breaks when empty, one charge per shot, shard ammunition limit. Each glowing fragment carries its own remaining charges. One shot spends one charge; when a shard is empty, it breaks apart.

Moonstone shard controls. use. equip shard, aim shard, fire shard, shard firing controls, aiming a moonstone shard, equipping a moonstone shard. Equip: One shard or the sling. Aim: Face the intended direction. Fire: Press Space.
Zubakon. requirement. later swings eligibility, sword training eligibility, experience eligibility, learning later sword swings. Zubakon can teach the later swings once experience makes you eligible.
Sword charge timing. combat. charge before contact. Charge before contact. Do not wait until you are beside a creature to ready the swing.
Hit and withdraw. combat. powerful foes. Hit and withdraw. Against powerful foes, secure one blow and back away before the return strike.
Combat movement. combat. dodge slower creatures. Keep moving. Slower creatures can be dodged; your moving feet make you harder to hit.

Combat pause. use. menu healing potion, pause combat from menu, drink healing potion during combat. Use the pause. Opening the menu pauses combat, giving you time to drink a healing potion before the health bar empties.

Guide source policy. explanation. original manual, official cluebook, location authority. Story and controls follow the original manual. Locations, inhabitants, and route notes follow the official cluebook; when decoded game metadata disagrees, the cluebook is the location authority.

Mechanics source policy. explanation. spell values, Weapons Master source. Mechanics and spell values follow the original game manual; Weapons Master locations and practical combat advice follow the official cluebook.
Marid Lord path. route. North Path, chessboard Marid. North Path (Marid Lord): Down 5 → East 3 → Up 1
Djinn Lords path. route. East Path, chessboard Djinn. East Path (Djinn Lords): West 5 → Up 3 → East 1
Dao Lord path. route. West Path, chessboard Dao. West Path (Dao Lord): East 5 → Down 3 → West 1
Efreet Lord path. route. South Path, chessboard Efreet, South chessboard path, South chessboard route, Efreet Lord chessboard route. South Path (Efreet Lord): North 5 → East 3 → South 1

Quick Swing. combat. Front, Click the action button, basic attack, quick attack, basic swing, front attack, quick swing controls. A fast scimitar strike in the direction the Corsair faces—or toward the sword cursor when using the mouse. Click the action button. Available at second level.

Wide Swing. combat. Front + both sides, Release when the second action circle lights orange, wide attack coverage, wide swing controls, second orange action circle. A stronger cut that damages monsters in front of the Corsair and to his left and right. Release when the second action circle lights orange. Learn from Zubakon after becoming eligible.

Full-Circle Swing. combat. All sides, Release when the third action circle lights orange, full circle attack coverage, full circle swing controls, third orange action circle, attack monsters behind. The most powerful swing: a complete 360-degree cut that also catches monsters behind the Corsair. Release when the third action circle lights orange. Learn from Zubakon after later progression.
Cone of Cold. use. Cone of Cold shard, Cone of Cold damage, Cone of Cold range. A cone of extreme cold that freezes everything it touches. Range: 10 yd. Damage: 12–30.
Flame Arrow. use. Flame Arrow shard, Flame Arrow damage, Flame Arrow range. A fiery bolt whose larger damage applies to creatures affected by flame. Range: 20 yd. Damage: 1–6 + 4–24 fire.

Lightning Bolt. use. Lightning Bolt shard, Lightning Bolt damage, Lightning Bolt range, lightning ricochet risk, lightning returning toward caster, lightning wall bounce. Strikes every target in its path and can ricochet from walls—even back toward the caster. Range: 100 yd. Damage: 6–36 per target.
Magic Missile. use. Magic Missile shard, Magic Missile damage, Magic Missile range. Three missiles seek the nearest visible enemy in the direction faced. Range: 120 yd. Damage: 6–15 total.
Sundazzle. use. Sundazzle shard, Sundazzle damage, Sundazzle range. Dancing colored spheres temporarily blind the target. Range: —. Damage: No damage.

Sunfire. use. Sunfire shard, Sunfire damage, Sunfire range, sunfire self damage immunity, own solar blast safety. An explosive ball of solar flame; the Corsair is never damaged by his own blast. Range: 70 yd. Damage: 6–36.

Sunscorch. use. Sunscorch shard, Sunscorch damage, Sunscorch range. An unerring heat beam that curves around obstacles and punishes targets touching substantial metal. Range: 60 yd. Damage: 4–24 + 2–8 metal.
Water Blast. use. Water Blast shard, Water Blast damage, Water Blast range. A fast-moving shot of water that seeks its target like a magic missile. Range: 60 yd. Damage: 2–12.
Air Elemental. combat. Air Elemental strategy. Air Elemental: Avoid storm spins. Attack immediately after they finish spinning. Danger: Medium.
Giant Boar. combat. Giant Boar strategy. Giant Boar: Charges in straight lines. Dodge sideways, then strike from behind. Danger: Medium.
Acid Slime. combat. Acid Slime strategy. Acid Slime: Leaves toxic pools. Do not stand in green residue. Strike from range. Danger: Medium.
Fire Elemental. combat. Fire Elemental strategy. Fire Elemental: Immune to fire. Apply Water Blast shards or Oil of Fire Invulnerability. Danger: High.
Hag. combat. Hag strategy. Hag: Casts magic missile streams. Evade behind columns, strike during cooldown. Danger: High.
Scaly-Horned Ogre. combat. Scaly-Horned Ogre strategy. Scaly-Horned Ogre: Huge health pool. Evade heavy clubs and ready a strong sword swing before closing. Danger: High.
Cyclops & Ettin. combat. Cyclops & Ettin strategy. Cyclops & Ettin: Devastating melee damage. Run in, hit once, back out. Use Giant Strength. Danger: High.
Family Sword of Honor. use. Family Sword of Honor effect. Family Sword of Honor: Magical scimitar that cannot harm allies or innocents. The primary weapon.
Ship Orb. use. Ship Orb effect. Ship Orb: Powers and restores the corsair ship for navigation.
Enchanted Mirror. use. Enchanted Mirror effect. Enchanted Mirror: Reflects magical light beams to solve optics puzzles.
Efreet Potion. use. Efreet Potion effect. Efreet Potion: Grants immunity to the chessboard death flames.
Key of Bone. use. Key of Bone effect. Key of Bone: Opens the secret passage in the castle kitchen cellars.
Vizier's Journal. use. Vizier's Journal effect. Vizier's Journal: Contains incriminating evidence detailing the Vizier's betrayal.
Purple Berries. location. Western Desert Oasis berries. Purple Berries: Western Desert Oasis.
Bottle of Eternal Emptiness. use. Efreet agent trap, bottle traps Efreet agent, bottle clears chessboard path. Bottle of Eternal Emptiness: Traps the Efreet agent, clearing the chessboard path.
Purple Berries. use. medicinal berries, berries for Babazar daughter. Purple Berries: Medicinal berries needed to cure Babazar's daughter.
Tarik. identity. Corsair brother, your brother Tarik. your brother Tarik
